title: Tailwise Grooming Salon Pass Terms — Holding Passes Across a Household
content:
**Clause — one live pass per pet.** A customer of the Tailwise Grooming Salon may hold one live grooming pass per pet, and passes for as many pets as they have. No other pass of the same customer for the same pet is in status active or suspended. A second pass for the same pet is sold only once the current one is exhausted, expired or cancelled; buying ahead is not offered. Passes of different pets are never pooled: a visit is always redeemed from the serviced pet's own pass.

**Basis of the check.** Whether another live pass exists is read from the company's pass records before the sale, never from the customer's account of it. The pass records are matched on the same customer and the same pet; a pass held for a different pet of the same customer is no obstacle. There is no limit on how many pets of one customer may each hold a pass.

**Pass statuses at a glance**

| Status of the customer's existing pass for this pet | A new pass for this pet may be sold |
|---|---|
| active | no |
| suspended | no |
| exhausted | yes |
| expired | yes |
| cancelled | yes |
| no existing pass for this pet | yes |

The same table applies to Groom Club Monthly, which is held as a pass for one pet like any other pass in the range.

**Illustrations (hypothetical household)**

- A customer holds an active Full Groom Pass 4-Visit for their dog and asks for a Bath & Tidy Pass 4-Visit for their cat. The cat has no live pass, so the cat's pass may be sold.
- The same customer asks for a second Full Groom pass for the dog while the first still has visits and is active: not sold; buying ahead is not offered.
- The dog's pass has run out of visits and shows exhausted: a new pass for the dog may be sold.
- The dog's appointment cannot be redeemed from the cat's pass, even if the cat's pass has visits left; passes are never pooled.
